claim: Try realistic sample data without changing your real thoughts.
where: Capture first screen, Demo banner, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context; save one real thought, enter the demo, add a demo thought, start for real, and confirm only the real thought remains.

claim: Thought text, voice clips, and review decisions are not uploaded by the app.
sandbox: Fresh demo session; capture text and fake-media audio, park it, archive a thought, and record every request. Only the product origin may be contacted.

claim: Use Thought Parking without an account or sync.
sandbox: Fresh browser profile; capture, reload, and review a thought without sign-in while request recording confirms no identity or sync origin is contacted.

claim: Capture, review, backup, and voice recording make no analytics or third-party content requests.
sandbox: Fresh demo session; complete text capture, fake-media recording, JSON export, and review while recording requests. Only the product origin may be contacted.

claim: Microphone access is requested only after you press Record voice.
sandbox: Fresh demo session with getUserMedia instrumentation; confirm zero microphone requests before activation and one request after pressing Record voice.

claim: Record a short voice clip and save it with a thought.
sandbox: Fresh demo session with Playwright fake microphone; record, stop, save, review, and confirm the local audio control is present.

claim: Use Ctrl/Command+Shift+Space to focus capture from anywhere.
sandbox: Fresh browser context on the Privacy page; press the desktop shortcut and confirm Capture opens with its field focused.

claim: Export a complete JSON backup, including voice clips; a newer copy replaces a matching thought ID on import.
sandbox: Fresh demo session; save a fake-media clip, export JSON, confirm the audio data is present, import a newer matching sample record, and review the replaced text.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh /demo session in a service-worker-controlled browser; add a thought, set the browser offline, reload /demo, and review the saved thought.

claim: Review one thought at a time, oldest first, then archive or promote it.
sandbox: Fresh demo session; begin review, confirm the oldest waiting sample appears alone, archive it, and confirm the next sample appears.

claim: Core capture stays free; a $7 one-time supporter license adds a local 14-day return snapshot and custom return cue.
where: Capture facts, My data, README, Terms
sandbox: Fresh demo session; leave with Start for real, complete a free capture, confirm the prescribed $7 Sociobot checkout URL, mock a valid return token, and confirm supporter tools are restored.
